episodes.name: Episode One
episodes.overviewEn: Matt Ryan returns as DC’s legendary demon hunter, John Constantine, to take on a monstrous foe from his past.

episodes.name: Episode Two
episodes.overviewEn: John summons the Nightmare Nurse to help in his battle to save Trish.

episodes.name: Episode Three
episodes.overviewEn: Constantine struggles with sins of the past while traveling to Los Angeles.

episodes.name: Episode Four
episodes.overviewEn: John unwittingly unleashes an unspeakable evil that will haunt the rest of his days.

episodes.name: Episode Five
episodes.overviewEn: John meets the demon Beroul and is given an agonizing choice.
